ex.en: Please bring your credentials to the interview.
ex.zh: 面試請攜帶你的證明文件。

ex.en: The school received official accreditation.
ex.zh: 這所學校獲得正式認證。

ex.en: She has an aptitude for numbers.
Patience is an important attribute for teachers.
ex.zh: 耐心是老師的重要特質。

senses.en: /əˈtrɪbjut/ He attributed his success to hard work.

coll.zh: 把 A 歸因於 B

ex.en: What are your main strengths?
Everyone has strengths and weaknesses.
ex.zh: 每個人都有優點和缺點。

ex.en: The company has a strong track record of growth.
ex.zh: 這家公司有穩定成長的紀錄。

ex.en: Please attach two reference letters.
My former boss wrote me a recommendation letter.
ex.zh: 我前主管幫我寫了推薦信。

ex.en: A letter of reference is required.
I saw the job posting on the company website.
ex.zh: 我在公司網站看到職缺公告。

ex.en: There are many job listings online.
We advertised the position in the newspaper.
ex.zh: 我們在報紙上刊登了職缺。

ex.en: We hope to fill the position by next month.
ex.zh: 我們希望下個月前補人。

ex.en: The turnover rate dropped after the pay raise.
We will reduce staff through attrition, not layoffs.
ex.zh: 我們會透過自然減員，而不是裁員。

ex.en: Job satisfaction is high in our company.
ex.zh: 我們公司的工作滿意度很高。

ex.en: Flexible hours help work-life balance.
ex.zh: 彈性工時有助工作生活平衡。

ex.en: Long hours can lead to burnout.
Employees can file a grievance with HR.
ex.zh: 員工可以向人資提出申訴。

ex.en: Lateness may result in disciplinary action.
He received a written warning.
He was dismissed for misconduct.
Employees will receive severance.
Laid-off workers will get three months' severance pay.
ex.zh: 被裁員工將獲得三個月資遣費。

ex.en: The company offers outplacement services.
ex.zh: 公司提供轉職協助服務。

ex.en: Many retirees volunteer at the museum.
ex.zh: 很多退休人士在博物館當志工。

ex.en: He took early retirement at 55.
Employees can join the pension plan.
ex.zh: 員工可以加入退休金計畫。

ex.en: The company matches 401(k) contributions.
ex.zh: 公司會相對提撥 401(k) 退休金。

ex.en: The human resources manager will explain the benefits.
Please send your resume to the personnel manager.
ex.zh: 請把履歷寄給人事經理。

ex.en: Contact the payroll department about your paycheck.
Staffing levels are low during the holidays.
ex.zh: 假期期間人員配置較少。

ex.en: We hired temporary workers through a staffing agency.
ex.zh: 我們透過人力派遣公司雇用臨時工。

ex.en: Workforce planning helps us prepare for growth.
ex.zh: 人力規劃幫助我們為成長做準備。

ex.en: The company values diversity in the workplace.
We promote diversity and inclusion.
We are an equal opportunity employer.
ex.zh: 我們是提供平等機會的雇主。

ex.en: Discrimination of any kind is not allowed.
The company has a strict policy against harassment.
ex.zh: 公司對騷擾行為有嚴格規定。

ex.en: Companies must follow labor laws.
The union representative met with management.
ex.zh: 工會代表和管理階層會面。

ex.en: Wages are set through collective bargaining.
ex.zh: 工資透過集體協商決定。

ex.en: The workers went on strike for higher pay.
The staff staged a walkout.
The board will convene next Tuesday.
The chairman presided over the meeting.

m: 故意的；審慎的；仔細考慮

ex.en: The committee will deliberate before deciding.
ex.zh: 委員會會先仔細討論再決定。

ex.en: After much deliberation, we chose the second plan.
ex.zh: 經過深思熟慮，我們選了第二個方案。

ex.en: We had a brainstorming session for the new campaign.
ex.zh: 我們為新活動開了腦力激盪會議。

ex.en: The board made a unanimous decision.
The plan was approved by a majority vote.
The motion was passed by the committee.
ex.zh: 委員會通過了這項動議。

ex.en: Will anyone second the motion?
They decided to table the motion until next month.
ex.zh: 他們決定把動議擱置到下個月。

usage: 美式指「擱置」，英式指「提出」

ex.en: The proposition was rejected.
The client made a counterproposal.
He gave a strong rebuttal to the criticism.
ex.zh: 他對批評做了強力反駁。

ex.en: The company refuted the claims.
Critics contend that the plan is too costly.
ex.zh: 批評者主張計畫成本太高。

ex.en: She asserted that the figures were correct.
The manager emphasized the importance of safety.
ex.zh: 經理強調安全的重要性。

ex.en: The report underlines the need for change.
Let me reiterate our main goals.
ex.zh: 讓我重申我們的主要目標。

ex.en: Could you elaborate on your proposal?
ex.zh: 你可以詳細說明你的提案嗎？

ex.en: Please elaborate on the budget changes.
I need some clarification on the schedule.
ex.zh: 行程方面我需要一些說明。

ex.en: Please specify the size and color.
Please read the synopsis before the meeting.
The abstract summarizes the research.
The executive summary is on the first page.
There will be a short briefing before the event.
ex.zh: 活動前會有簡短說明會。

ex.en: The team was debriefed after the project.
ex.zh: 專案結束後團隊做了檢討匯報。

ex.en: Please submit a weekly progress report.
The status report shows we are on schedule.
ex.zh: 狀態報告顯示我們進度正常。

ex.en: The findings will be presented next week.
The report includes five recommendations.
Let's review the action items from last week.
ex.zh: 我們來檢視上週的待辦事項。

ex.en: Let's discuss the next steps.
We scheduled a follow-up meeting for Friday.
ex.zh: 我們安排了週五的後續會議。

ex.en: The minutes of the meeting were sent to everyone.
Who will take minutes today?
The recording secretary read last month's minutes.
ex.zh: 紀錄秘書宣讀上月的會議記錄。
